name: real-captain-invite-burnaby-c
description: Standalone Admin SDK script that creates exactly ONE real Captain invite for teams/bk-d2-team-1 (Burnaby Arms C, Division 2, Bedford & Kempston District) in chalkie-app-staging, mirroring functions/src/index.ts's performCreateTeamInvite field-for-field. Refuses to run unless every pre-flight check (team identity, empty captainUserId, no existing pending Captain invite) passes. Never creates an Auth account, a users/{uid} document, a player record, or touches viceCaptainUserId. See README.md before running anything.
